biography.plain_text: Jasmin Drygala Troike, known professionally as Jasmin Troike, is a horse breeder and equestrian-facility operator based in Lübeck. She runs the Groß Steinrade riding centre with Lars Roman Paech. Riding from childhood, she had her first lesson at nine and her first pony at thirteen, and works closely with trainer Tessa Frank.

long_biography.plain_text:
Jasmin Troike bred and owned Billy, a Westphalian mare entered in the breed association’s spring auction. She also owned Rovereto, a Hanoverian she sold to Austria’s Ahorner family as a young-rider prospect. The horse subsequently reached Grand Prix under Marcus Hermes.

At the riding centre she operates, forty stalls sit alongside indoor schooling and lunging arenas, outdoor dressage and jumping areas, summer pasture and winter paddocks. Horse care includes arranging visits from farriers Andreas and Joe Radtke. After her horse Biene was shod, she led it across the yard while Joe checked its movement.
